items.title: Sandisk Sinks 14% as Memory Stocks Give Back Nvidia’s Huang Rally
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSandisk fell 14% today, giving back most of Monday’s Nvidia rally, and Coherent fell with it. None of the three had news of its own: Nvidia slid on reports of an unconfirmed SEC probe.

items.title: Applied Optoelectronics Climbs 5% on $2.2 Billion Hyperscaler Supply Deal; Lumentum and Coherent Drop 6%
items.summary: While AI stocks sell off, one small optical player is rallying on a massive four-year contract from a mystery buyer. But a thin profit, heavy dilution, and a stalled factory expansion raise a harder question about whether it can deliver.

items.title: Coherent Stock Is Jensen Huang Reinstatement Changing The AI Partner Story
items.summary: Coherent Corp. has authorized a share repurchase program of up to US$2.0b with no expiration date, after its board approved the plan on 18 November 2026. The buyback sits alongside Coherent's growing role as an optical partner to Nvidia for AI data centers, linking capital allocation directly to its AI driven communications business. items.title: Coherent Is Up 55% in a Year, and Its CEO Says 2027 Is “Basically Booked Out.” Time to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent stock is up 55% in a year but about half below its June high, as AI hardware swung on spending fears, the midterms and Nvidia’s turmoil. September-quarter revenue rose 50%, and management guides above 60% pro forma growth for fiscal 2027.

items.title: Coherent Is the Real Winner of Huang’s Return. Nvidia Paid $2 Billion for Its Stock
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent shares jumped 15% after Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, a week after Coherent fell 9% on Nvidia’s leadership turmoil. Nvidia paid $2 billion for Coherent stock in March and is the lead customer for the co-packaged optics Coherent expects to start selling in the December 2026 quarter.

items.title: CoreWeave, Nebius lead neocloud stocks higher as Jensen Huang's Nvidia return lifts AI trade
items.summary: CoreWeave and Nebius shares soared on Monday as CEO Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia, a major backer of the AI trade.
